<details><summary>What the change connects to (18 closed, 1 open)</summary>

Questions the reviewer answered about what this change does to the running product. The engine checked that the cited lines exist, not that the answers are true.

**Open: the reviewer could not close these**

- Library no longer installs window-wide file drop handling (ImportDropZone/useFileDrop removed from the Library) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-file-drop.test.tsx:1`) — Does anything else (a global dragover/drop preventDefault in the shell, or a will-navigate handler) stop Electron from navigating when a file is dropped on the Library or on other non-Export pages? Files that would answer it: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library/library-page.tsx`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/app/router.tsx`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/index.ts`.

**Closed, with the lines they rest on**

- Dropped or browsed video is imported and Export opens on it with the selected destination (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:85`) — Navigates to /export/<new>?to=<dest>. When more than one file is dropped, a toast names the others. If it fails: Import failures are handled inside useImportVideos, which this part does not change. A navigation still happens after refresh() resolves. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-import.ts:36-57`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/prepare-path.ts:12-15`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:77-88`.
- Probe of the source video gates the Export screen ('Reading…' until ready) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:92`) — 'Reading…' centered text, then the screen. On error, a toast and the drop zone. If it fails: probeSource is a chain of mediabunny awaits with no timeout. It catches rejections and returns null (the error path). Nothing bounds the whole chain, so a read that never settles leaves 'Reading…' on… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-copy.ts:42-67`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/probe-source.ts:28-47`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:95-99`.
- Document-level keydown: Enter exports, arrow keys move the destination (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:277`) — Starts copy.start(), or opens the existing copy in Library detail. A busy export shows a toast. If it fails: Enter does not skip dialogs. With the picker open and focus off a button, Enter exports (reported as a finding). Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:356-386`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/video-picker.tsx:45-75`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-copy.ts:97-101`.
- Email destination passed to the export runner and the status cards (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-copy.ts:119`) — The progress and ready cards fall back to the ICU 'other' branch ('your export'), as the PR describes. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:55-57`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-runner.ts:59`.
- Legacy /prepare URLs redirect to /export with the query kept (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:168`) — Lands on Export with ?to= preserved. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/routes.ts:18-24`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/app/router.tsx:68-74`.
- Library stops handling window file drops (useFileDrop/ImportDropZone removed) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library/library-page.tsx:53`) — A file dropped on the Library makes Electron navigate the main window to the file URL, replacing the app UI. If it fails: The main process has no will-navigate guard, so the navigation is not blocked and the app UI is lost until restart. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-file-drop.ts:8-15`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-file-drop.ts:29-47`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-import.ts:55`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/index.ts:400-403`.
- Pick a video in VideoPicker (Change video / Pick from Library) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/video-picker.tsx:86-89`) — Export reopens on the picked video with the same destination selected. If it fails: If the new file can't be read, the probe errors, a toast appears and the app navigates to /export (export-page.tsx:95-99). Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:84-88`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:95-99`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:150-153`.
- Primary Export / Export again button in DestinationStage (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-stage.tsx:121-139`) — The background export runner starts, and RecentExports and the rail badge show progress. If it fails: Runner failures go through the existing export runner toasts, which this part doesn't change. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:252-266`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:321-324`.
- Open a finished copy from Recent exports (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/recent-exports.tsx:68`) — The copy's page opens. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:112`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library/library-page.tsx:359`.
- Export rail item badge counts the running export plus unannounced finished copies (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:111-123`) — Badge number and aria label 'N copies in progress or ready' on the Export rail link. If it fails: The runner is in-memory and synchronous. On error, status becomes 'error' and the running count drops to 0. On finish, the state becomes idle with `ready` set, and noteFinishedCopy adds a copy that i… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:111-123`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/ready-copies.ts:50-75`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-runner.ts:26`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-runner.ts:462`, `packages/i18n/messages/en.json:946`.
- A file dragged from the OS and dropped on the Library page (the import door was removed) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library/library-page.test.tsx:80`) — The platform default runs: Electron navigates the main window to the dropped file, and the app UI is replaced. If it fails: The renderer state is lost, including an export running in the background. No error is shown, and the test stays green because it never checks whether the drop's default was prevented. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-file-drop.ts:8-11`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-file-drop.ts:40-51`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-import.ts:55`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:85`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/index.ts:400-411`.
- A video dropped on Export is imported and Export opens on it, keeping the destination picked on screen (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.test.tsx:485`) — Export re-renders on the new asset with the destination taken from the query. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:75-88`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-import.ts:42-52`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/prepare-path.ts:12-15`.
- Enter on a destination card or the page runs the primary action; Enter on other buttons or in fields does not (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.test.tsx:285`) — The copy starts, or the existing copy opens. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:262-301`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:375-386`.
- Sidebar Export entry: active on /export and /export/:assetId, carries the ready-copies badge that the Library item used to carry (`apps/kaipu-record/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:53`) — Rail item badge count with railBadge label; sidebar tests assert it moved off Library and clears on Export or Library. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:53`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:79-81`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:111-123`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.test.tsx:44-64`, `packages/i18n/messages/en.json:946`.
- Drop zone wrapper is no longer a scroll box (overflow-y removed) on Export with no video (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-drop-zone.module.css:2-11`) — The VideoPicker popover below its button is not clipped. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:101-114`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/recent-exports.module.css:2-7`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/recent-exports.tsx:19`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/window-size.ts:50`.
- New `export` / `exportNew` routes in the shared ROUTES table; `/export/*` keeps the main window preset (`apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/routes.ts:18`) — Going to Export from any sidebar page does not resize the window; the window-size test pins `/export/abc-123` and `/export` to `main`. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/routes.ts:17-24`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/window-size.ts:82-88`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/window-size.test.ts:17-31`.
- Rail EXPORT entry badge uses the new `export.railBadge` plural message (`packages/i18n/messages/en.json:946`) — The rail shows a count with an accessible label in en and es. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:53`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:79-81`.
- Size bar tone switched from `data-direction` to `data-tone` (adds fits/over for GitHub) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-stage.module.css:262`) — GitHub's bar is teal under the 10 MB limit and amber over it; for other destinations the colour follows the copy's direction. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-stage.tsx:299-307`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-stage.tsx:320-330`.

<details><summary>What the reviewer checked</summary>

**Batch 1 of 6.** Part 1 of 6 has two "consider" findings and nothing that blocks the merge.

The routing works as the PR describes. `/export` and `/export/:assetId` are live, the old `/prepare` URLs redirect with `?to=` kept, and `preparePath()` / `prepareNewPath()` keep their signatures and now return Export URLs. Dropped and browsed videos still go through the unchanged `usePrepareImport` and open on Export with the picked destination. Email is its own destination on the Balanced preset; passing the destination explicitly is what lets its copy carry "email", and the cards' "your export" wording is the decision the PR already names.

Findings:

- **Enter can export behind an open dialog** (`export-page.tsx:375`). The Enter check doesn't skip `role="dialog"`, though the arrow-key check does. With the Change video / Pick from Library list open and focus on something other than a button, Enter starts an export behind the list.
- **Library detail links are built by hand** (`export-page.tsx:112`, again at line 162). `/library/${assetId}` is hard-coded and not encoded, while the rest of the file uses `ROUTES`.

One existing limit carries over from Prepare: the source-video read has no timeout, so a file that never finishes reading leaves "Reading…" on screen. That code is unchanged, so I didn't report it as a finding.

**Batch 2 of 6.** I reviewed the five files in part 2. There is one fix-level problem. The Library no longer mounts `useFileDrop`, and nothing else blocks the default file drop: no other screen-level drop listener, and no `will-navigate` guard in the main process. So a video dropped on the Library makes Electron load the file in the app window, which contradicts step 12 of the PR's test plan. I could not confirm this against a running Electron build, so it is reported at medium confidence. I also raised a consider-level accessibility point: the 1440p/4K and Fill/Fit radiogroups don't handle arrow keys. `export-page.tsx` skips arrows in those groups because it assumes they handle them themselves, and they don't. The rest of `DestinationStage`, `RecentExports` and `VideoPicker` matches the plan and runner types they use.

**Batch 3 of 6.** Part 3 covers the Prepare page deletions, the sidebar's new Export item and badge, the `useFileDrop` tests that moved out of `import-drop-zone.test.tsx`, and the Email destination in `destinations.test.ts`. Nothing still imports the deleted Prepare files. `isPrimaryEnter` and the probe-error redirect survive in `export-page.tsx`. The Export badge logic (running export plus unannounced copies, cleared on `/export*` and `/library`) matches `ready-copies.ts` and `export-runner.ts`. The finish transition does not double count, because the copy whose ready card is on screen is excluded. The destinations test matches `destinations.ts`: Email shares Balanced, and `destinationOfPreset("balanced")` still returns "chat". One gap: no test drives the in-progress count. Outside this part, `useFileDrop`'s own comment says an unhandled file drop makes Electron navigate the window to the file, and `main/index.ts` sets no will-navigate guard. Now that the Library no longer mounts the hook, a drop there may navigate away from the app instead of doing nothing. This is worth confirming in the Library part.

**Batch 4 of 6.** I read all three test files in this part and checked them against `export-page.tsx`, `use-prepare-import.ts`, `use-file-drop.ts`, `prepare-path.ts` and the main window setup.

- **`export-page.test.tsx`:** its assertions match the page's code: the Enter and arrow-key guards, keeping the destination after a drop or a video change, the redirect for old `/prepare` URLs, reusing a copy that already exists, and the unreadable-file path.
- **`library-detail-page.test.tsx`:** the only change is swapping `/prepare` for `/export`, which matches `preparePath`.
- **`library-page.test.tsx`:** this is the one finding. The Library no longer mounts a window-level drop guard. Nothing in main stops navigation either. So dropping a file on the Library now makes Electron load the file in place of the app, which also kills any export running in the background. The new test only checks that nothing was imported, so it stays green and treats this regression as the intended behaviour.

**Batch 5 of 6.** Part 5 is mostly stylesheets and test moves, and I found no defects. Every CSS custom property it uses is defined, in tokens.css or base.css. Nothing still imports the deleted Prepare page or ImportDropZone stylesheet. The deleted prepare-page tests have counterparts in export-page.test.tsx: drop handling, several files, non-video files, busy exporter, unreadable probe and legacy redirects. Two gaps in the sidebar tests: the "with and without a video" test only checks the URL with a video, and nothing tests the in-progress count the new badge label adds.

**Batch 6 of 6.** Part 6 is in good shape: I found two small cleanup and comment issues and no bugs.

- **Routes:** the new `/export` routes in `shared/routes.ts` are plain literals with no value imports, which respects the shared-directory import rule. `/export*` also keeps the main window size, as the updated window-size test checks.
- **i18n:** the deleted `library.import*` and `prepare.prepareAVideo` keys are no longer used anywhere in the renderer. The new `export.*` keys and the email destination keys are used, and `en.json` and `es.json` have the same keys.
- **Stylesheets:** every class `export-stage.tsx` uses is still defined in `export-stage.module.css`, including the new `data-tone` selectors on the size bar.
- **Docs:** the backlog doc's claims about the rail badge, the ←/→/Enter keys and the GitHub free-plan limit match the code.

The two findings, both "consider":

- `library-page.module.css:108` still has the comment for the deleted `.importZone` rule. It now sits on top of the `.stickyBar` comment and reads as if it described the sticky bar.
- The comment at the top of `export-stage.module.css` calls 900 × 670 the default window size. That is the minimum; the window opens at 1040 × 760.

</details>
